schedule: Dependency order only; no time estimates or dates are commitments.

tasks.title: Freeze scope and deployment inputs
deliverables: Scope ledger and unresolved input manifest
No-AI-in-tickets invariant recorded as superseding earlier proposals
Sophie identity decision and source-asset set recorded; no-AI boundary unchanged
tasks.guardrail: No new product features or implicit approvals; all unknown IDs and credentials remain unset.

tasks.title: Approve licence scope and persistence choice
deliverables: Exact dependency/runtime/model inventory and notices
Owner decision for indirect/tooling/platform scope; one approved storage and queue design
tasks.guardrail: Do not install unknown/non-MIT components or invent a custom database to bypass a gate.

tasks.title: Inventory and baseline Windows host
deliverables: CPU/RAM/disk/service/port inventory
Resource baseline and deployment/recovery constraints
tasks.guardrail: Read-only inventory; do not disrupt existing services or claim unmeasured model speed.

tasks.title: Discover Discord, wiki and design inputs
deliverables: Guild/role/channel ownership matrix and approved member baseline method
MediaWiki capabilities, approved sources and website asset/token evidence
Final Shuttle copy/forms and retention inputs
Inspect the supplied Sophie manifest and existing WUFF addendum; distinguish these from still-unverified site tokens and load measurements
tasks.guardrail: No guessed IDs, website CSS, content licences or admission requirements.

tasks.title: Bootstrap repository and contract checks
deliverables: JavaScript ESM repository with runtime schemas/JSDoc
Locked approved dependencies, CI and module-boundary tests
Synthetic fixtures and build manifest
tasks.guardrail: No production secrets; TypeScript only after explicit approval.

tasks.title: Implement authentication and shared capability policy
deliverables: Discord/OAuth actor resolution and sessions
Shared capability/access-epoch policy
CSRF, guild binding and negative permission tests
tasks.guardrail: UI visibility cannot substitute for backend checks.

tasks.title: Implement durable storage and outbox
deliverables: Logical schema realised in the approved engine
Migrations, transactions, uniqueness, leases/fencing
Idempotency, retry and reconciliation contracts
tasks.guardrail: Treat external delivery as at-least-once; no exactly-once claim.

tasks.title: Package native service skeleton
deliverables: Version-matched service scripts and ACL layout
Separated core/knowledge/inference identities
Liveness/readiness and redacted logs
tasks.guardrail: Do not expose inference/database or run as a personal administrator.

tasks.title: Build dashboard shell and shared controls
deliverables: Capability-aware navigation and common forms/tables/dialogs
Accessible Sophie shell using bundled reference assets, with production placement approval still required
Configuration draft/validate/publish flow
tasks.guardrail: No case AI widgets or page-context injection into previews.

tasks.title: Implement Discord adapter and command plumbing
deliverables: Pinned Oceanic compatibility evidence
Gateway routing, prompt acknowledgment and modal handling
Shared service invocation and rate-limit/error behaviour
Apply the shared Sophie display identity in staging; live profile/avatar changes require release approval
tasks.guardrail: Only the core owns the production token; optional voice remains absent.

tasks.title: Implement ticket provisioning and state
deliverables: Case type/form versions and opener/subject/participant separation
Private-channel provisioning with operation markers
Recoverable open/close state
tasks.guardrail: Reported subject is never auto-invited.

tasks.title: Implement case permissions and staff lifecycle
deliverables: Effective permission validation and category-change handling
Claim/reassign/participant/close/reopen services
Restricted staff notes and audit events
tasks.guardrail: Do not promise privacy from Discord Administrator privileges.

tasks.title: Implement transcripts and attachment policy
deliverables: Authenticated private artifacts and escaped rendering
Bounded attachment path and coverage-gap reporting
Owner-approved retention enforced
tasks.guardrail: No public permanent transcript links or AI ingestion.

tasks.title: Implement Shuttle content editor and definitions
deliverables: Immutable published workflow versions
Owner-provided copy/forms, preview and withdrawal/migration controls
tasks.guardrail: No generated admissions rules; no infinite visual workflow builder.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic Shuttle progression
deliverables: Start/resume/advance/back/human-help state machine
Component nonce/version checks and control reconstruction
tasks.guardrail: Neither Discord role visibility nor a model determines progress.

tasks.title: Implement role ownership, restoration and revocation
deliverables: Role ownership/restoration allowlists
Eligibility epochs and revocation-safe reconciliation
Stale/offline snapshot handling
tasks.guardrail: No privileged-role restoration or external-bot role interference.

tasks.title: Integrate final Shuttle grant and recovery
deliverables: Acknowledged/role-pending/complete outcomes
Grant confirmation, late-effect compensation and operator repair
Human assistance and logged overrides
tasks.guardrail: Success requires confirmed delivery; AI is never involved.

tasks.title: Complete staff ticket UX and commands
deliverables: Permitted queues, case detail, notes and participant controls
Human replies, canned-answer selection and transcripts
Command/dashboard parity
tasks.guardrail: No summaries, drafting, triage or conversation-transfer AI.

tasks.title: Implement simple automation and curated answers
deliverables: Literal/bounded rules, cooldowns, mention suppression
Join/static response previews and manually curated answers
tasks.guardrail: Generic auto-responses ignore tickets and bot/webhook loops.

tasks.title: Enforce AI exclusion at every boundary
deliverables: Ingress/delivery classification guard and permanent case exclusions
Worker/database/filesystem isolation
Sentinel tests and architecture import restrictions
tasks.guardrail: No toggle or staff bypass can enable AI inside cases.

tasks.title: Implement MediaWiki ingestion and sync
deliverables: Capability-aware API connector and rendered snapshots
Cursor/checkpoint, template dependency, deletion and review pipeline
Provenance/rights and collection restrictions
tasks.guardrail: No guessed endpoint, broad Discord scrape or case archive source.

tasks.title: Implement direct lookup and source authority
deliverables: Exact/alias/lexical retrieval and valid source links
Audience/version-aware caches and authority conflicts
Model-independent /lookup
tasks.guardrail: No semantic model dependency for basic lookup.

tasks.title: Implement knowledge administration
deliverables: Source/collection review and snapshot comparison
Sync diagnostics, quarantine, deletion and safe previews
tasks.guardrail: Preview has no case-context or transcript import path.

tasks.title: Provision and benchmark local model
deliverables: Model/runtime hash and licence lock
CPU-only llama.cpp hardening and measured limits
Cold/warm latency/memory/load benchmark report
tasks.guardrail: No cloud fallback, auto-download or claimed unmeasured throughput.

tasks.title: Implement non-ticket knowledge assistant
deliverables: Dedicated-channel /ask and short-lived bounded sessions
Application-directed retrieval and source-ID validation
Final delivery revalidation and blank staff-contact link
Bounded Sophie style profile with citations, truthful action claims and no ticket exceptions
tasks.guardrail: No ticket data/tools, case advice automation or arbitrary browsing.

tasks.title: Implement AI controls and evaluation tooling
deliverables: Model/limits/queue/cancel/disable dashboard
Versioned prompts and evaluation ledger
Public-knowledge previews and redacted diagnostics
tasks.guardrail: No persistent member profiling or case-content feedback.

tasks.title: Implement backups, deletion and operator runbooks
deliverables: Retention/deletion ledger and consistent artifact backups
Isolated restore/rollback scripts and evidence
Independent outage alert/fallback process
tasks.guardrail: Do not replay restored jobs into production.

tasks.title: Run administration failure and permission suite
deliverables: Recorded G2 results for crashes, permissions, restores and role races
Defect fixes and build-specific evidence
tasks.guardrail: Tests use synthetic cases; findings block release until resolved.

tasks.title: Run knowledge/AI isolation, quality and load suite
deliverables: G3/G4 evidence and reviewed 40-question minimum set
Sentinel, permission, deletion and model-failure results
Resource usability sign-off on actual host
tasks.guardrail: Zero prohibited data/tool paths; no ticket material used in tests.

tasks.title: Approve brand implementation and accessibility
deliverables: Approved theme tokens/assets/provenance
Keyboard/contrast/reflow/quiet-mode evidence
Core staff workflow review
Sophie crop, transparency, fallback and neutral-case presentation review
tasks.guardrail: Do not infer exact live-site assets from this planning pack.

tasks.title: Approve administration pilot and cutover ledger
deliverables: Reviewed existing-member eligibility baseline
Bot responsibility/old-case drain plan
Backup, fallback and operator release approval
tasks.guardrail: Administration approval does not depend on local AI readiness.

tasks.title: Cut over administrative responsibilities
deliverables: Single-writer feature transfers and monitored pilot results
Old panels retired safely; old cases drained without migration
Rollback/incident evidence and current release record
tasks.guardrail: Do not remove old ticket access while open cases still need it.

tasks.title: Activate direct knowledge then approved AI
deliverables: Source/AI channel approvals and final source freshness check
Scoped rollout and disable/fallback test
Published local-processing notice
tasks.guardrail: Direct lookup can go live earlier under G3; AI remains separately gated.

tasks.title: Add selected read-only service adapters
deliverables: Owner-approved platform/resource inventory
Scoped connector credentials and contracts
SSRF, timeout, audience and source-provenance tests
tasks.guardrail: No automatic writes, BYOND duplication or broad generic network tool.

tasks.title: Add small community utilities
deliverables: Prioritised suggestions, message-context reports or announcements
Bounded scheduler and human-curated answer workflow
tasks.guardrail: Choose one feature slice at a time; no ticket AI or unreviewed code ports.

tasks.title: Establish maintenance and upgrade cadence
deliverables: Dependency/API/model revalidation procedure
Operator ownership and recovery-drill schedule proposal
Documented agent PR and release protocol
tasks.guardrail: No unattended production upgrades or recurring jobs without owner approval.

tasks.title: Import Sophie identity and source assets
deliverables: Four manifest-selected original PNGs in a versioned local asset root
Shared brand-profile contract, SHA-256 validation and source provenance
Legacy-human-art exclusion and explicit publication/derivative review records
tasks.guardrail: No regeneration, relabelled artwork licence, remote asset loading, extra model runtime or technical service renaming.

tasks.title: Apply Sophie branding to interfaces and static copy
deliverables: Avatar/header/hero/wordmark placement with live-text and quiet-mode fallbacks
Identity controls separate from AI settings and case permissions
State-derived, owner-reviewed static templates for ticket and Shuttle notices
tasks.guardrail: No AI inside cases, mascot chat widget, rewritten admission rules, unsupported success claims or unreadable decorative surfaces.

tasks.title: Review identity consistency and non-AI presentation
deliverables: Small/circular/narrow-layout previews and alpha checks on light/dark surfaces
Brand-preview and deterministic-case sentinel test evidence with zero model calls
Versioned asset approval and rollback record for the administration release
tasks.guardrail: Artwork review is not a production benchmark or legal certification. Do not block human administration on local-model readiness.
